item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO, Shares Fall 10% Pre-Market
item.description:
Jensen Huang has stepped down as Nvidia CEO and left its board after 33 years, three days after the board opened an outside probe into reports he was a foreign intelligence target. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO and director Harvey Jones becomes the company's first board chair; shares fell about 10% pre-market, extending two weeks of losses to roughly $1.4T. Huang resisted succession planning, leaving dozens of direct reports and no clear No. 2, while the next CEO inherits about $100B in investments including a planned $10B Anthropic share purchase at its IPO next week.

原文标题：黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 股价盘前跌 10%

Why it matters：全球最重要算力公司的最高层突发更替，直接牵动 AI 芯片供应、千亿美元投资版图与 Anthropic 上市节奏。

item.title: Jensen Huang Resigns as NVIDIA CEO, CFO Colette Kress Takes Interim Role
item.description:
NVIDIA's board announced that Jensen Huang has resigned immediately as President, CEO and board member, with EVP and CFO Colette Kress stepping in as Interim CEO while a permanent successor search begins. The board also created its first-ever Chair role, filled by Harvey C. Jones. The change at the helm of the world's dominant AI compute supplier will shape GPU roadmaps and industry expectations.

原文标题：黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO 首席财务官临时接任

Why it matters：全球 AI 算力龙头创始人兼 CEO 即刻离任，属产业级重大人事地震，影响面覆盖整个 AI 基础设施生态。

item.title: ElevenLabs Releases Scribe v3 Speech Recognition Models
item.description:
ElevenLabs has launched Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live, speech recognition models for pre-recorded and real-time audio, tuned for messy conditions such as crosstalk and background noise. The live version uses conversational context to avoid cutting callers off during brief pauses. Artificial Analysis benchmarks place Scribe v3 among the most accurate transcription models, though it is slower and pricier than rivals from Microsoft and xAI.

原文标题：ElevenLabs 发布 Scribe v3 语音识别模型

Why it matters：语音识别是语音智能体的关键底座，实时上下文断句能力与准确率、成本权衡值得关注。

item.title: Anthropic Files for IPO as Quarterly Revenue Hits $17 Billion
item.description:
Anthropic has formally launched its IPO, reporting $17 billion in quarterly revenue, up more than 12x year over year, with customers paying $100K+ growing 12x to over 11,900. Of the $23.3B net loss, $21.9B is a paper loss tied to convertible notes, while the company highlights a 4x improvement in revenue per dollar of compute since early 2025.

原文标题：Anthropic 启动 IPO 季度营收 170 亿美元

Why it matters：头部大模型公司启动 IPO 并披露罕见的高增长营收与算力效率数据，是 AI 商业化进程的关键节点。

item.title: iFlytek Opens SparkAudio 1.0 Speech Foundation Model API with 99-Language Support
item.description:
iFlytek has launched API access to SparkAudio 1.0, its speech foundation model, on the iFlytek Open Platform. The model understands speech end-to-end instead of the cascaded transcribe-then-reason pipeline, covering 99 languages and 202 dialects across transcription, translation, speaker diarization, emotion analysis and audio QA, and is trained entirely on domestic compute.

原文标题：讯飞星火语音基座 SparkAudio 1.0 上线 API 支持 99 种语言

Why it matters：国产语音基座模型开放 API，端到端音频理解替代级联方案，语言与方言覆盖量级突出。

item.title: UnionPay and Ant Group Launch All-in-One Payment Terminal
item.description:
UnionPay and Ant Group unveiled an all-in-one payment terminal in Xi'an that accepts Alipay Tap, domestic and international bank cards, QR codes, mobile Pay and digital yuan on a single device. The terminal aims to cut merchants' multi-device overhead and improve payment accessibility for inbound tourists and elderly users. Alipay Tap has reached 2,200 scenarios, 30 million offline touchpoints and 400 million users since launching in July 2024.

原文标题：银联与蚂蚁推出全功能融合支付终端

Why it matters：支付基础设施的硬件级整合，涉及数字人民币与跨境支付受理，具备实际落地价值。

item.title: DeepMind Releases AlphaGenome 2 with Doubled Variant Discovery
item.description:
Google DeepMind has released AlphaGenome 2, advancing genomics AI from bulk-tissue predictions to single-cell-type resolution for forecasting genetic variant effects in specific human cell types. In testing it surfaced nearly twice as many relevant gene variants as its predecessor and is now available for noncommercial research.

原文标题：DeepMind 发布 AlphaGenome 2 基因组预测精度翻倍

Why it matters：这是 AI for Science 领域的重要节点，单细胞分辨率预测显著提升变异解读能力，对基因组研究与药物靶点发现具有实质价值。

item.title: MiniMax Open-Sources H3-Image Model with Native 4K Output
item.description:
Following its open-source video model H3, MiniMax released H3-Image, an open-source image generation model supporting native 4K output at roughly RMB 0.2 per image. It shows strong performance on structural decomposition, game assets, e-commerce visuals and fine-grained portrait details, marking a notable open-source push into multimodal generation.

item.title: Asus Posts NT$50.5B Nine-Month Profit as AI Server Revenue Doubles
item.description:
Asus reported NT$50.48 billion in net profit for the first nine months of fiscal 2026, up 52.25% year over year, on revenue of NT$742.43 billion. Third-quarter server revenue more than doubled and AI PC revenue grew over 100%, lifting brand operating profit by 161%. However, delayed customer data-center buildouts pushed some server orders into Q4, while inventory rose 36% sequentially and bank borrowings jumped 150%.

item.title: Moonshot Executive Says AI Iteration Speed Will Keep Accelerating
item.description:
Xu Tiantian, Moonshot AI's head of finance industry and ecosystem, told the Caixin Summit that AI intelligence is far from its ceiling, with three growth curves—pretraining compute, post-training and inference, and agent design—compounding to accelerate iteration. She added that agents can independently handle ever-longer tasks, pushing AI from odd jobs into deeper workflows.

原文标题：月之暗面高管称 AI 迭代速度将继续加快

Why it matters：来自头部大模型公司高管对 AI 迭代节奏的判断，三条增长曲线与智能体任务时长延长的观点具备行业参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Blocks Claude From Generating Pokemon IP Content
item.description:
Anthropic has added explicit restrictions to Claude blocking generation of Pokemon intellectual property, including character designs, names, music and levels, marking the first time the model targets a specific game franchise. The move extends earlier broad safeguards against AI cloning of existing video games, signaling vendors are proactively drawing copyright boundaries.

item.title: Ex-ByteDance Executive Chen Lin Returns with AI Education Startup Galaxy Zhixue
item.description:
Chen Lin, former senior vice president of ByteDance, founded Galaxy Zhixue in December 2024 and used an education technology conference to detail the architecture of its product Xiaolu Aixue. The system pairs the Doubao foundation model with a self-developed learning engine built on deep knowledge tracing, item response theory and cognitive diagnosis, aiming to diagnose how students learn rather than merely generate solutions. The disclosure remains architectural and conceptual, with no verified large-scale classroom outcome data yet.

原文标题：陈林再创业银河智学 用双核架构切入课堂

Why it matters：明星创业者入局教育 AI 并披露具体技术栈，对关注垂直行业落地路径的读者有参考价值，但缺乏可验证效果数据。

item.title: JPMorgan Forecasts US Humanoid Robot Output of 400,000 Units by 2030
item.description:
JPMorgan projects US humanoid robot output will reach 300,000 to 400,000 units by 2030 and about 1.5 million by 2035, driven by labor shortages and falling costs. The report flags dexterous hands, actuators, robot brains and production capacity as key bottlenecks, noting most US makers target only 10,000 to 30,000 units annually and that component suppliers offer better near-term investment opportunities than OEMs.

原文标题：摩根大通预测 2030 年美国人形机器人产量达 40 万台

Why it matters：投行首次给出人形机器人量化的中长期产能预测与零部件市场规模，是判断具身智能产业化节奏的重要参考。

item.title: Anthropic Kicks Off IPO Roadshow at $1.4 Trillion Valuation
item.description:
Anthropic has officially launched its IPO roadshow, planning to offer 825 million shares at $70-78 each for a deal size of up to roughly $64.35 billion, with trading on Nasdaq under ticker ANT expected November 19. Amid a broad AI sector selloff, its potential valuation has fallen from about $2 trillion to roughly $1.4 trillion, a drop of around 30%, while early shareholders could cash out $22.1-24.6 billion on day one.

原文标题：Anthropic 启动 IPO 路演 估值缩水至 1.4 万亿美元

Why it matters：这是 AI 行业史上最大规模 IPO 之一的关键节点，估值缩水与市场恐慌情绪对判断 AI 资本周期具有重要参考价值。

item.title: Australia Drafts Law Mandating Independent Safety Audits for Frontier AI Models
item.description:
Australia's Albanese government unveiled its first mandatory safety law for frontier AI models, requiring developers to submit to independent audits, run continuous safety checks, publish safety frameworks, and report incidents immediately. A new oversight body will enforce compliance alongside the Australian AI Safety Institute with steep penalties, with details to follow public consultation.

原文标题：澳大利亚拟立法强制前沿模型接受独立安全审计

Why it matters：这是主要经济体首次以立法形式强制前沿模型开放独立审计，对全球 AI 监管走向与厂商合规成本有直接参考价值。

item.title: Grok Build Apps Expose 35,000 Unauthenticated Endpoints
item.description:
Security firm Claroc found that over 35,000 apps built with Grok are accessible without authentication, with roughly 650 to 800 containing private data, including internal sales tools and employee performance records from SpaceXSI, X and Tesla, plus ICU patient records and plaintext credentials. The root cause is that Grok assigns each app a hard-to-guess random subdomain but relies on obscurity rather than real access control. Apps created by SpaceXSI and X employees have been taken offline, while many third-party apps remain exposed.

原文标题：Grok 构建应用泄露 3.5 万个未授权访问入口

Why it matters：头部 AI 编程平台出现大规模鉴权缺失导致真实机密外泄，是 AI 应用安全范式的标志性事件。

item.title: Hong Kong Launches First HarmonyOS Government App iAM Smart
item.description:
Hong Kong's Digital Policy Office and Huawei Device kicked off development of a HarmonyOS edition of the iAM Smart platform on November 9, making it the territory's first HarmonyOS government app. With over 1,400 services and 4.9 million users, the adaptation targets cross-border HarmonyOS device users and hardened identity authentication.

MSI reported NT$10.45 billion in net profit for the first three quarters of 2026, up 153.9% year over year, even as revenue fell 5.5%. With memory prices squeezing PC costs, the company is expanding into NVIDIA MGX-based rack-scale AI infrastructure and liquid-cooled GPU servers.

item.title: SMIC Net Profit Jumps 91.6% to 7.31 Billion Yuan in First Nine Months
item.description:
SMIC reported 60.62 billion yuan in revenue and 7.31 billion yuan in net profit for the first nine months of 2026, up 22.4% and 91.6% year over year, driven by higher wafer shipments, rising utilization and an improved product mix. Third-quarter revenue reached 21.98 billion yuan with net profit of 2.85 billion yuan, as utilization climbed above the prior quarter's 93.7% and 12-inch wafers rose to 78.9% of mix.

item.title: Huawei Cloud to Unveil CloudRobo Embodied World Model on November 16
item.description:
Huawei Cloud has scheduled an online launch on November 16 for CloudRobo-WM1.2, the first Ascend-native world model under its Industry AI Dream Factory platform. The model targets embodied intelligence scenarios, consistent with Huawei Cloud's strategy of building platforms and models rather than robot hardware. Only the name and date have been disclosed so far, with no technical details yet.

item.title: Dubai Billionaire Says OpenAI and Anthropic Bets Yield Billions
item.description:
DAMAC founder Hussain Sajwani said at Bloomberg's Dubai investment forum that his stakes in OpenAI, SpaceX and Anthropic alone have earned billions of dollars, with his net worth now above $13 billion. He acknowledged valuation pullback risk, while Blackstone flagged digital infrastructure and compute demand as prime opportunities and PIMCO expected digital infrastructure lending growth to slow.

item.title: ZTE Xuanji Builds Ontology-Driven Semantic Layer for Enterprise AI
item.description:
ZTE has introduced Xuanji, an ontology-driven semantic software platform aimed at filling the enterprise semantic gap left by LLMs and RAG. It organizes business knowledge as concepts, attributes, relations and rules, maps them to database tables, fields and APIs, and turns natural-language questions into structured queries and rule-based reasoning. The platform connects multi-source data below and exposes REST API, GUI, LUI, SDK, Webhook and Skills/Tool/MCP interfaces to agents and business applications across procurement, supply chain and finance.

Why it matters：提出以本体语义层补足企业 AI 语义缺口的架构思路，但属厂商授权转载，缺少参数与可验证落地数据。

item.title: South Korea Unveils 40 Million Dollar Edge AI Chip Roadmap for 2030
item.description:
South Korea's Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy unveiled a roadmap for edge AI semiconductor development, committing 800.2 billion won (about 400 million yuan) to complete development and validation of 10 AI chips by 2030. The chips target smart appliances, autonomous driving, collaborative and humanoid robots, agricultural robots, drones, plus advanced-node and extreme-environment projects, with Samsung and other foundries prioritizing MPW tape-out slots and IP vendors cutting design costs.

原文标题：韩国投 40 亿元推进端侧 AI 芯片 2030 年验证 10 款

Why it matters：国家级端侧 AI 芯片路线图落地，涉及代工产能与 IP 成本机制，是观察 AI 算力供应链区域化的重要信号。

item.title: Meta 基础设施负责人卸任 亚马逊老将接棒
item.description:
Meta 证实，长期负责基础设施业务并兼任工程部门联合负责人的桑托什·贾纳尔丹将卸任，由今年加入 Meta 的前亚马逊高管戴夫·布朗接任。贾纳尔丹将在过渡期留任并转任 Meta Compute 顾问，明年正式离职。此次交接正值 Meta 大幅加码 AI 数据中心投资之际，关键基础设施业务将迎来新管理者。

item.description:

TrendForce 预测 2026 年第四季度 PC DRAM 价格环比再涨 13~18%，客户端 SSD 上涨 0~5%。OEM 内存库存自三季度起持续走高，部分厂商已要求重谈明年供应合同，并计划削减四季度至明年一季度的采购规模。
